results.title: We Are Aliens
results.overview: One summer in the third grade, a quiet boy named Tsubasa meets Gyotaro, a boy everyone in the class looked up to, and the two become close friends. Within their small world, they share irreplaceable moments—until a small incident suddenly tears them apart.

results.title: NJPW Yuji Nagata Produce Blue Justice XIX ~Aogi Futotsu~
results.original_title: NJPW Yuji Nagata Produce Blue Justice XIX ~Aogi Futotsu~
results.overview: Blue Justice XIX ~Aogi Futotsu~ was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on September 6, 2026 at Togane Arena in Togane, Chiba, Japan.

results.title: Saming
results.overview: While searching for his missing sister in Northern Thailand, a fitness vlogger is introduced to the legend of Saming, a shapeshifting tiger that consumes and replaces its victims. Ignoring warnings from the locals, he ventures into the jungle, believing his sister vanished there. As his trek leads him deeper into the brush, his companions disappear one-by-one, and he finds himself stalked by a mysterious spirit in the form of his sister.

results.title: Damilola Taylor: The Untold Story
results.overview: Ten-year-old Damilola Taylor was fatally stabbed in 2000 in a stairwell in Peckham, South East London, just metres from his home. 'Star Wars' star John Boyega, who also grew up in Peckham, speaks for the first time about being one of the last people to see him alive, sharing the fear and uncertainty that followed in the aftermath of Taylor's death. Boyega is joined by close friends and family members of Taylor, who reveal the events that led to his death and talk for the first time about the impact his tragic murder has had in shaping their lives.

results.title: Neon Banana
results.overview: A seemingly innocent online interaction quickly turns precarious.

results.title: Voices
results.overview: When a rising soul duo overdose just hours before their big break, a desperate bellhop and his closest friends seize the chance of a lifetime, only to discover that the price of fame is blood.

results.title: Angkinin Mo Ako
results.overview: Cess Garcia and VMX’s next big thing Dara Lima star in a steamy drama about two sisters and the man who sparks their sensual awakening. A female lawyer hires a young man as tutor for her younger sister but unknown to her, their review sessions are becoming wild

results.title: Nuclear Deterrent - A Strategy for Europe
results.original_title: Atommacht Europa? Auf der Suche nach neuer Sicherheit
results.overview: Until recently, Europe felt safe under the US nuclear umbrella. But since Russia invaded Ukraine and Donald Trump was re-elected, transatlantic relations have deteriorated. Experts are calling for Europe to focus more on its own nuclear deterrent. But what options do nations on the continent have?

results.title: Big Girls Don't Cry
results.overview: Over one transformative summer in rural New Zealand in 2006, 14-year-old Sid discovers desire, identity, and the internet as she imitates the people she longs to be loved by.

results.title: Feels Like Home
results.overview: Rita, an ordinary, but lonely woman is kidnapped. Her captors are the Árpáds; they claim she is not called Rita but Szilvi, a runaway from their family. Rita eventually understands that the only way out is in - to escape she must impersonate Szilvi. The more she becomes the lost girl the more she finds out about the family - and understands that her life is on the line.

results.title: Love on the Amazon
results.overview: Claire travels to Brazil and hires Danny, a riverboat captain, to help her deliver an important message for her sister Amelia, a marine biologist studying pink dolphins on the Amazon River.

results.title: VHS
results.overview: VIVA HORROR STORIES is a 3-in-1 horror anthology where every story has a secret, every secret has a price, and every nightmare leads to terror. A cheerleader is haunted by a sinister presence on campus; a seemingly perfect romance hides a horrifying secret; and a celebrity couple faces an unthinkable choice when their child is born disfigured. Three terrifying stories. Three unforgettable nightmares. One anthology that will make you scream

results.title: Next Door
results.overview: In a pristine suburb, three couples unravel as abuse, infidelity, drugs, and a missing son resurface.

results.title: Love Sitter
results.overview: A lonely man’s quiet life changes when he unexpectedly becomes the caretaker of a mischievous cat. Through this unusual responsibility, he forms a heartfelt connection with the cat’s owner, leading to a promise that changes both their lives forever.

results.title: Irréalisable
results.overview: Six strangers come together for a week-long vacation at the stunning Mimosas guesthouse.  With its warm and inviting atmosphere, life there feels perfect. The hosts, Greg and his wife, Sublima, are incredibly charming and attentive, ensuring their guests feel right at home.  But beneath the surface of this idyllic retreat, danger lurks. One of the guests harbors a sinister plan, unknowingly entangling everyone in a web of deceit.  What begins as a dream getaway is about to spiral into a nightmare.

results.title: L&O - Law and Order
results.overview: After losing his son to a drug empire, DYSP Balagopal joins four fearless recruits to take down the ruthless Pacha and his cartel. The return of legendary gangster Karikkamuri Shanmughan sets the stage for an explosive final showdown

results.title: Ducks
results.overview: A young Frenchman of Cambodian origins goes to his country in search of himself.
